title: Business Central Case Study: Engineer-to-Order Manufacturing at Zook
summary: ZOOK, a manufacturer of rupture disks and pressure-safety devices, demonstrates how Business Central and Dynamics NAV support complex engineer-to-order manufacturing with custom extensions. The case study shows how partner expertise in manufacturing combined with deep customization achieved significant operational efficiencies.
key_points: Custom product configurator determines production methods, inspection rules, and documentation requirements beyond simple component selection for engineer-to-order products.
Automation reduced certificate generation from 30 minutes to 2 minutes while enabling production of 30+ different document types sold across 170+ countries.
Shipping integration for Canadian UPS operations was reduced from 20 minutes per shipment to 2 seconds through custom interface development; ZOOK handles 45-80 daily Canadian shipments.
ZOOK's approximately 30% customized NAV environment is being evaluated for migration to Business Central with careful assessment of which customizations are still needed versus standard capabilities.
